newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady in busy trade, arb shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady in busy trade, arb shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady on Tuesday in busy trading, buoyed by a rebound in futures prices and anchored down by a closed arbitrage to the United States, brokers said.

Eurograde barges ended unchanged at $188/$189 fob ARA. Deals were heard as low as $185 in the morning and as high as $193 for prompt refinery material, they said, with barges also done at $186.50, $188, $189, $189 and $191, also for prompt nomination.
Brokers said as long as the arbitrage remained shut it would prevent any steep gains in barge prices.
"Europe has to come off to open it," said one trader. "So that's why I'm going to sell it."

Gasoline inventories in the 15 countries of the European Union plus Norway fell by 5.95 million barrels, or 3.6 percent, in May to 160.99 million, Stitching Euroilstock said. That is 4.27 million or 2.6 percent below a year ago.
Traders were also awaiting weekly U.S. inventory data due out after the close on Tuesday.
